results.title: Big Mac®: McDonald's Special Beef Burger
highlights:
# Big Mac® 

When a craving hits for those two all-beef patties it’s time to stop thinking about what’s on a Big Mac® and take a bite. The McDonald's Big Mac is a 100% beef burger with a taste like no other. The mouthwatering perfection starts with two 100% pure all beef patties and Big Mac Sauce sandwiched between a sesame seed bun. It’s topped off with pickles, crisp shredded lettuce, finely chopped onion and a slice of American cheese. It contains no artificial flavors, preservatives or added colors from artificial sources. McDonald’s pickles contain an artificial preservative, so skip it if you like. 

There are 580 calories in a Big Mac
